meta_home_title: Enduva: endurance, strength and nutrition in one app
meta_home_description: Enduva brings endurance training, strength training and nutrition together in one app for iPhone, Apple Watch and the web. Currently in development.
hero_title: Endurance, strength and nutrition in one app
hero_lead: Enduva brings your runs, rides and swims, your strength sessions and what you eat together in one place: on iPhone, Apple Watch and the web.
pillar_endurance_body: Import workouts from Apple Health, follow your training load, fitness and form, and see your progress over weeks and months.
pillar_strength_body: Log sets quickly in the gym, on your iPhone or straight from your Apple Watch, and track how your lifts develop.
pillar_nutrition_body: Track meals with European food data and barcode scanning, with energy and macro targets that follow your training.
ai_title: AI as a coach, not an oracle
ai_body: Optional AI features will review your sessions, draft training plans and suggest adjustments when life gets in the way. You decide whether to use them: AI processing needs your separate consent, and its suggestions are not medical advice.
cta_body: Enduva is in early development and sign-up is not open yet. You can follow the progress on GitHub.
